versions.changelog:
Initial release of replace-in-video.

- Swap a single on-camera element (character, object, or garment) in an existing video while preserving original motion, timing, camera, lighting, background, and audio.
- Accepts a source video, 1–3 reference images, and a prompt specifying what to replace and what to keep.
- Uses the Pruna P-Video-Replace model (`prunaai:p-video@replace`) for element swaps; supports up to 3 reference images for better identity match through movement.
- Asynchronous workflow: submit task, poll for completion, and retrieve final video output.
- Detailed guidance for preparing reference images, writing prompts, and managing multi-element swaps provided.
- Optional parameters for output resolution, frame rate, audio preservation, and source audio sync.
